text:
**The evidence does not establish whether clearing is happening today.** The annual tree-cover-loss data extend through 2025, but the supplied results report a loss event only for 2021; they do not say whether loss occurred in later years.

In 2021, 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss were recorded, representing 2.23% of the property. Most of that event area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted pine forest, with none mapped as native forest. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than the event-reporting threshold.

More recent imagery or monitoring would be needed to assess clearing in 2026.
